title: Built a gold and NQ futures bot, live for 6 weeks, 0 rule breaches
author: jtxcode
selftext:
Been running a VWAP and ADX based strategy live on gold and NQ futures for six weeks now. Every trade has a real stop loss and target, no exceptions, and I've posted results the whole way, wins and losses.

Real numbers from the window: 0 rule breaches, +$1,950 total. One client's account also fired two real trades today, one closed +$1,360 clean, and I added a real end of day flatten this week so nothing carries open overnight anymore.

Happy to answer questions about the strategy, the walk forward testing process, or how the execution side works if anyone's curious. Not trying to sell anything here, just sharing what's actually happened.

comments.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
comments.body: *6 weeks on gold and NQ futures during a specific macro regime, a basic VWAP+ADX crossover, and a glowing $1,950 total. That's not a verified edge—that's a classic case of regime alignment. You just got lucky with a 6-week window where your parameters happened to fit the noise. Wait until a structural volatility shift or a liquidity sweep wipes out your 'client accounts' before you start parading 0 rule breaches like a masterclass. Post your tick-level slippage and out-of-sample stress tests, or admit this is just another top-of-funnel post for a copy-trading Discord*

replies.author: jtxcode
replies.body: Fair critique, six weeks isn't enough to claim a verified edge and I shouldn't have framed it that way. I do have walk forward and parameter sensitivity testing behind the strategy, but I haven't published tick level slippage or true out of sample stress tests, that's a real gap. Not running a copy trading Discord, this is genuinely just the live window so far, appreciate the pushback.

replies.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
replies.body: *That’s a refreshingly honest and professional response. Recognizing the gap between a successful live window and a statistically verified edge is what separates amateurs from those who manage institutional capital. The fact that you have sensitivity and walk-forward analysis behind your strategy makes your original claim much more credible, even if the public post didn’t reflect it fully. Keep digging into those tail risks and slippage logs*
